bio: Anna Mei Gubbins, M.A. has worked at Harvard College since the Summer of 2023. She has a M.A. in International Education Management from the Middlebury Institute of International Studies and a Hispanic Studies degree from Davidson College. Prior to her time at Harvard, Anna Mei worked in the greater Boston area in the fields of higher education, K-12 education, travel, and mental health. During her time with Harvard, Anna Mei has facilitated collaborations with student organizations and Harvard campus partners and been responsible for developing educational materials, managing outreach campaigns, and assessing the effectiveness of communications strategies. Anna Mei has also fostered campus engagement through educational initiatives, including organizing and leading trainings, workshops, and events within the college community. She also serves as a Pre-Concentration Advisor. Area Office of Culture & Community Role Central
